verdict.rationale:
dlt provides a declarative rest_api source covering auth, pagination, and streams (dlt-docs-23, dlt-docs-63), an OpenAPI-to-pipeline generator (dlt-init-openapi, dlt-docs-25/32/55/78), and a dedicated AI Harness with skills/rules/MCP servers that teach coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) to draft production-grade pipelines from API docs, including a concrete GitHub REST API example (dlt-docs-45, dlt-docs-58/69/80) and a claim of powering 11,200+ REST API sources for AI assistants (dlt-docs-17). Users then review/ship via CLI and dltHub deploy (dlt-docs-10, dlt-docs-68).
Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of an AI actually drafting a working connector end-to-end (no community report specifically validating this AI-drafting workflow), and no explicit detail on how well auto-generated pagination/auth code holds up without manual fixes.
